name: Sika Plastiment-55
paste:
SIKA® PLASTIMENT®-55: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Plastiment®-55, April 2023, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/r/sika-plastiment-55.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Plastiment®-55 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Plastiment®-55 is a special formulated water reducing admixture based on selected polycarboxylate ethers, which provides a cost effective solution in achieving water reduction.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Plastiment®-55 is used to improve the efficiency of the water content in concrete mixes to achieve increased workability without loss of strength or to increase strength without loss of workability. It can be used for pumped and structural concrete. Sika® Plastiment®-55 is the ideal product for burnished finish concrete flooring.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Plastiment®-55
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: WR-WATER REDUCING ADMIXTURE
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.03) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Improve workability and finishability
    - Ideal product for slump up to 120 mm
    - Easier and quicker placing and compaction
    - The water reduction properties as well as the dispersion characteristic enhance the strength gained at all ages
    - Enhances a consistent and controlled bleeding rate through water reduction and mix cohesivness
    - Sika® Plastiment®-55 enables concrete to achieve internal cohesiveness with improved placement properties
    - Higher dosage rates deliver proportional setting time delay
    - Sika® Plastiment®-55 delivers excellent finishing in slab and flooring concrete
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Selected copolymers in aqueous solution
    - Appearance and colour: Dark grey liquid
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk deliveries; 1000 L IBC; 10 L container
    - Shelf life: Stored at temperatures between 5°C and 35°C in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight, shelf life is 12 months.
    - Storage conditions: Store at temperatures between 5°C and 35°C , protected from direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.03) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Dispensing: Sika® Plastiment®-55 is added with the batching water. Never add to a dry mix.
    - Compatibility: Sika® Plastiment®-55 can be used in conjunction with all the Sika Concrete Admixtures, excluding Sikament NN. For additional information, please contact your local Sika Representative.
4.3 Recommended dosage. Recommended dosage is 400 ml ± 100 ml per 100 kg of total cementitious material. This dosage can be increased to 800 ml 100 kg of total cementitious material to improve water reduction and increase setting time. Optimum dosage should be determined by site trials with the particular mix design and materials.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.03) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Plastiment®-55, April 2023, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/r/sika-plastiment-55.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika Plastiment 55, version 23/07/2024, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/Sika%20Plastiment-55.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
